inputFields.name: user
inputFields.description: The user id an image-based service runs as, which also owns its mounted volumes.

types.name: Agent
types.description: An agent in an environment: a harness with instructions, the connectors it is granted and the network it may reach.

fields.name: allowedHosts
fields.description: Hosts on the internet the agent may reach directly, without credentials. `*.example.com` covers the subdomains of `example.com`.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: Written into the harness's own instruction file, next to its system prompt.

fields.name: privateNetwork
fields.description: Whether the agent may reach the other services of its environment.

fields.name: sessions
fields.description: The sessions of the agent, newest first.

types.name: AgentApproval
types.description: A tool call that waits for, or got, a decision from someone in the workspace.

fields.name: approval
fields.description: Pass this to `answerAgentApproval`.

fields.name: callId
fields.description: The tool call that needs the approval.

fields.name: decidedBy
fields.description: Null while pending, or once that person has left the workspace.

enumValues.name: ALLOW_ONCE
enumValues.description: Allows this one call.

types.name: AgentAuditEntry
types.description: One call an agent made to a model provider or a connector.

fields.name: connector
fields.description: The connector, for a tool call.

fields.name: modelProvider
fields.description: The model provider, for a model call.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The model of a model call, or the tool or method of a tool call.

enumValues.name: MODEL
enumValues.description: A call to a model.

enumValues.name: TOOL
enumValues.description: A call to a connector.

enumValues.name: DENIED
enumValues.description: Refused because the agent isn't allowed to make the call.

types.name: AgentConnector
types.description: A connector granted to an agent.

fields.name: hiddenTools
fields.description: Tools of the connector the agent doesn't see and can't call.

inputFields.name: hiddenTools
inputFields.description: Tool names of the connector to hide from the agent.

types.name: AgentID
types.description: An agent, as `workspace/project/environment/agent`. For example `acme/shop/production/ops-agent`.

types.name: AgentMessage
types.description: Text the agent wrote.

types.name: AgentModel
types.description: A model an agent can use, from one of the workspace's model providers.

types.name: AgentNotice
types.description: Something the harness flags about the session rather than says as the agent, like a model fallback or a safety stop.

types.name: AgentSession
types.description: One conversation with an agent. Every member of the workspace can see it and take part.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Everything that happened in the session, oldest first.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model of the next turn.

fields.name: startedBy
fields.description: Who started the session. Null once that person has left the workspace.

types.name: AgentSessionEvent
types.description: Something that happened in a session. Events with the same `callId` or `approval` describe the same call or approval, and the later one replaces the earlier one.

types.name: AgentSessionID
types.description: A session of an agent, as the agent id followed by the session. For example `acme/shop/production/ops-agent/s-q7m2xk`.

enumValues.name: FAILED
enumValues.description: The agent doesn't start.

enumValues.name: STARTING
enumValues.description: The agent is starting, or can't be reached yet.

enumValues.name: WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL
enumValues.description: At least one session waits for an approval.

enumValues.name: WORKING
enumValues.description: At least one session is working.

types.name: AgentToolCall
types.description: A tool the agent called.

fields.name: connector
fields.description: The connector the tool belongs to. Null for the harness's own tools, such as editing a file.

fields.name: input
fields.description: The arguments, as JSON.

enumValues.name: DENIED
enumValues.description: Someone in the workspace denied the call.

types.name: AgentTurnEnd
types.description: The agent ended its turn and waits for the next message.

enumValues.name: COMPLETED
enumValues.description: The agent finished its turn.

enumValues.name: STOPPED
enumValues.description: Someone stopped the session.

types.name: AgentUserMessage
types.description: A message someone in the workspace sent to the agent.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Null once that person has left the workspace.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The event's position in the session. Pass it as `after` to continue from here.

types.name: Approval
types.description: Whether an agent may use a connector's tools on its own.

enumValues.name: ALLOW
enumValues.description: The agent uses the tools without asking.

enumValues.name: ASK
enumValues.description: Every tool call waits for someone in the workspace to allow it.

types.name: Availability
types.description: Whether a workspace can use something now, and what unlocks it otherwise.

enumValues.name: AVAILABLE
enumValues.description: It can be used.

enumValues.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED
enumValues.description: A card on file unlocks it.

enumValues.name: PLAN_REQUIRED
enumValues.description: A higher plan unlocks it. `plan` names the cheapest one.

enumValues.name: UNAVAILABLE
enumValues.description: It isn't offered here.

types.name: Boolean
types.description: The `Boolean` scalar type represents `true` or `false`.

types.name: BucketID
types.description: A bucket, as `workspace/project/environment/bucket`. For example `acme/shop/production/assets`.

types.name: BuildID
types.description: A build, as `workspace/build`. Take it from the release it belongs to.

types.name: Capabilities
types.description: What a workspace can create, how large, and what unlocks the rest.

types.name: Capability
types.description: Something a workspace may use, and what unlocks it when it can't yet.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: The cheapest plan that unlocks it, when `availability` is `PLAN_REQUIRED`.

types.name: ComputeCapability
types.description: Creating services, and the CPU, memory and replicas of one.

fields.name: replicas
fields.description: The most replicas one service may run, the autoscaling maximum included.

types.name: Connector
types.description: A set of tools connected to the workspace, such as Linear or Sentry. Agents reach a connector only once they are granted it, and never see its credential.

fields.name: agents
fields.description: The agents granted this connector.

fields.name: checkedAt
fields.description: When the credential was last checked.

fields.name: credentialHint
fields.description: The last four characters of the credential, if it has one. The credential itself is never returned.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: The tools the connector listed at the last check.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The address of the connector's remote MCP server.

types.name: ConnectorID
types.description: A connector connected to a workspace, as `workspace/connector`. For example `acme/linear`.

types.name: ConnectorTool
types.description: A tool a connector offers.

types.name: CountCapability
types.description: Something counted across the workspace. `availability` already accounts for how many exist.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: How many the plan allows. Null means unlimited.

types.name: CountUpgrade
types.description: A higher count that another plan allows.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Null means unlimited.

inputFields.name: fromEnvironment
inputFields.description: Not supported yet. Leave it unset, because new environments always start empty.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: The project id. Derived from `name` when left out.

inputFields.name: name
inputFields.description: The display name of the project, such as `My API`.

types.name: CredentialStatus
types.description: The outcome of the last check of a credential.

enumValues.name: REJECTED
enumValues.description: The service turned the credential down.

enumValues.name: UNREACHABLE
enumValues.description: The service couldn't be reached, or didn't answer as expected.

fields.name: allowRules
fields.description: Address ranges allowed to connect over the public hostname. While the list is empty, nobody can.

fields.name: connectionLimit
fields.description: The most connections each instance accepts at once, or null while that isn't known.

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: Usage of the database over a time range. With grouping `PER_REPLICA` there is one series per instance, and replication lag only has series for replicas. With `TOTAL` the instances are added up, and replication lag is the largest of them.

fields.name: queryStatistics
fields.description: The statements that took the most time, read live from the primary.

fields.name: statusReason
fields.description: Why the database is in this state, when it is not healthy.

fields.name: range
fields.description: An IPv4 range in CIDR notation, such as `203.0.113.7/32`. `0.0.0.0/0` allows any address.

inputFields.name: description
inputFields.description: A note on whose address this is, such as `Office`.

inputFields.name: range
inputFields.description: An IPv4 address, such as `203.0.113.7`, or a range in CIDR notation, such as `203.0.113.0/24`. `0.0.0.0/0` allows any address.

types.name: DatabaseBackups
types.description: The backups of one database. Base backups are taken on a schedule and the write-ahead log is archived continuously in between, so any moment from `earliestRestorePoint` to `latestRestorePoint` can be restored.

fields.name: earliestRestorePoint
fields.description: The furthest back this database can be restored to.

types.name: DatabaseCapability
types.description: Creating databases, and the CPU, memory and storage of one.

types.name: DatabaseID
types.description: A database, as `workspace/project/environment/database`. For example `acme/shop/production/orders`.

enumValues.name: PRIMARY
enumValues.description: The instance that serves writes.

enumValues.name: REPLICA
enumValues.description: An instance that replicates from the primary and takes over if it fails.

types.name: DatabaseMetric
types.description: A measurement of a database that can be charted over time.

enumValues.name: CACHE_HIT_RATIO
enumValues.description: The share of reads served from memory instead of disk, from 0 to 1.

enumValues.name: CONNECTIONS
enumValues.description: Open connections, idle ones included.

enumValues.name: CPU_USAGE
enumValues.description: CPU in use, in cores.

enumValues.name: DEADLOCKS
enumValues.description: Deadlocks detected in each interval of the range.

enumValues.name: MEMORY_USAGE
enumValues.description: Memory in use, in bytes.

enumValues.name: REPLICATION_LAG
enumValues.description: How far a replica trails the primary, in seconds.

enumValues.name: ROWS_READ
enumValues.description: Rows read by queries per second.

enumValues.name: ROWS_WRITTEN
enumValues.description: Rows inserted, updated or deleted per second.

enumValues.name: STORAGE_USED
enumValues.description: Space taken on the storage of the database, in bytes.

enumValues.name: TRANSACTIONS
enumValues.description: Transactions committed or rolled back per second.

fields.name: instance
fields.description: The instance the series is about, or null when all instances are added up.

fields.name: role
fields.description: The role the instance has right now, or null when all instances are added up.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The statement, with its values replaced by placeholders such as `$1`.

fields.name: rows
fields.description: Rows returned or changed by the statement, over all calls.

fields.name: share
fields.description: The share of the time spent on all statements that went to this one, from 0 to 1.

types.name: DatabaseQueryStatistics
types.description: How much time a database spent on each statement since `since`.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: False when the database doesn't collect statement statistics, which is the case for some databases created before they were collected by default.

fields.name: queries
fields.description: The statements that took the most time in total, at most 25.

fields.name: since
fields.description: When counting started. Statistics start over when they are reset and when another instance becomes the primary.

types.name: DeployID
types.description: The deploy step of a release, as `workspace/deploy`. Take it from the release it belongs to.

types.name: DeploymentID
types.description: One deployment of a service, as its service id followed by a hash. For example `acme/shop/production/web/56bc5cdfc5`.

types.name: Effort
types.description: How hard the model thinks before it answers.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Base64-encoded zip archive of the ejected project.

types.name: EnvironmentID
types.description: An environment, as `workspace/project/environment`. For example `acme/shop/production`.

types.name: Float
types.description: The `Float` scalar type represents signed double-precision fractional values as specified by [IEEE 754](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_floating_point).

types.name: Harness
types.description: The coding agent that runs inside an agent.

enumValues.name: CLAUDE_CODE
enumValues.description: Claude Code. Uses Anthropic models.

enumValues.name: CODEX
enumValues.description: Codex. Uses OpenAI models.

enumValues.name: OPENCODE
enumValues.description: OpenCode. Uses the models of every provider.

types.name: ID
types.description: The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

types.name: ImageSearchResult
types.description: A public container image on Docker Hub.

types.name: Int
types.description: The `Int` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

types.name: KeyValueStoreID
types.description: A key-value store, as `workspace/project/environment/store`. For example `acme/shop/production/cache`.

types.name: ModelApi
types.description: The API a model provider speaks.

enumValues.name: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE
enumValues.description: Any API that speaks OpenAI's chat completions, such as Infomaniak, Scaleway or Mistral. Needs a `url`.

types.name: ModelProvider
types.description: A model API connected to the workspace. Every agent in the workspace can use it, as far as its harness supports the API.

fields.name: agents
fields.description: The agents whose harness can use this provider.

fields.name: checkedAt
fields.description: When the key was last checked.

fields.name: keyHint
fields.description: The last four characters of the key. The key itself is never returned.

fields.name: models
fields.description: The models the provider listed at the last check.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The base URL of the API.

types.name: ModelProviderID
types.description: A model provider connected to a workspace, as `workspace/provider`. For example `acme/anthropic`.

fields.name: addCustomDomain
fields.description: Adds a domain you own to a service, served once its DNS records check out. With `redirectTo`, the domain permanently redirects to another domain of the same service.

fields.name: addDatabaseAllowRule
fields.description: Allows an address range to connect over the public hostname of an exposed database. Adding a range that is already allowed updates its description.

fields.name: addPaymentMethod
fields.description: Starts a checkout that saves a card for the workspace without charging it, and returns its URL. `returnPath` is the dashboard path to come back to.

fields.name: addService
fields.description: Adds a service to an environment, either built from a GitHub `repository` such as `acme/api` or run from a container `image`. A repository build starts right away, and an image runs without one.

fields.name: answerAgentApproval
fields.description: Allows or denies a pending tool call.

fields.name: billingPortalUrl
fields.description: A link to the billing portal, where payment details and invoices are managed.

fields.name: bucketObjectUploadUrl
fields.description: A link to upload one object with an HTTP `PUT`, valid for 15 minutes. An existing object with the same key is overwritten.

fields.name: completePaymentMethodCheckout
fields.description: Confirms a finished card checkout. A prepaid card is removed again and refused with the code `PREPAID_CARD`.

fields.name: completePlanCheckout
fields.description: Completes the checkout a plan selection started, puts the workspace on the plan and returns the subscription.

fields.name: completeWorkspaceCheckout
fields.description: Completes a workspace checkout, lifts the workspace's suspension and returns it.

fields.name: createAgent
fields.description: Creates an agent in an environment. It starts without network access beyond the workspace's model providers and the connectors it is granted.

fields.name: createApiToken
fields.description: Creates an API token for the workspace with the given role. The `lucity_…` value is only returned in this response, and the token stays valid until it is revoked.

fields.name: createBucket
fields.description: Creates a private bucket in an environment.

fields.name: createConnector
fields.description: Connects a remote MCP server as a connector. `url` must use https. The connector is checked by listing its tools, and one that can't be reached or turns the credential down is not stored. The credential is sent as a bearer token.

fields.name: createDatabase
fields.description: Creates a PostgreSQL database in an environment. `size` defaults to `16Gi` or the plan's maximum when that is lower, and CPU and memory to `500m` and `512Mi`. Everything stays within the limits in `Workspace.capabilities`.

fields.name: createDatabaseBackup
fields.description: Starts a full backup of a database now. If a backup is already running, that one is returned instead.

fields.name: createEnvironment
fields.description: Creates an empty environment in a project.

fields.name: createKeyValueStore
fields.description: Creates a key-value store in an environment. `size` defaults to `1Gi`, within the limits in `Workspace.capabilities`.

fields.name: createModelProvider
fields.description: Connects a model provider. The key is checked by listing the provider's models, and a provider that can't be reached or turns the key down is not stored. `url` is required for `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE`, must use https, and is fixed for the other APIs.

fields.name: createProject
fields.description: Creates a project with an empty `development` environment. Services and resources are added to the environment afterwards.

fields.name: createVolume
fields.description: Creates a volume in an environment, with a `size` within the limits in `Workspace.capabilities`, at least `10Gi`.

fields.name: createWorkspaceCheckout
fields.description: Creates a workspace on a paid plan and returns the URL of the checkout that pays for it. The workspace stays suspended until the checkout completes.

fields.name: deleteAgent
fields.description: Deletes an agent with its sessions and files.

fields.name: deleteBucket
fields.description: Deletes a bucket and everything in it.

fields.name: deleteBucketObject
fields.description: Deletes one object from a bucket.

fields.name: deleteConnector
fields.description: Disconnects a connector and removes it from every agent it was granted to.

fields.name: deleteDatabase
fields.description: Deletes a database and all of its data.

fields.name: deleteEnvironment
fields.description: Deletes an environment. It has to be empty, and the last environment of a project can't be deleted.

fields.name: deleteKeyValueStore
fields.description: Deletes a key-value store and its data.

fields.name: deleteModelProvider
fields.description: Disconnects a model provider. Agents lose access to its models right away.

fields.name: deleteProject
fields.description: Deletes a project. Every one of its environments has to be empty first.

fields.name: deleteVolume
fields.description: Deletes a volume and its data. It has to be unmounted first.

fields.name: deleteWorkspace
fields.description: Deletes the workspace. It can't have any projects left, and a personal workspace can't be deleted.

fields.name: deploy
fields.description: Builds a service from source and rolls it out. `gitRef` takes a branch, tag or commit and defaults to the branch the service tracks. A deployer may only deploy services that build from its own repository and have CI deploys turned on.

fields.name: executeQuery
fields.description: Runs one SQL statement against a database, as the user from its credentials, and returns up to 1,000 rows with values as text. The statement commits right away and times out after 30 seconds.

fields.name: expandVolume
fields.description: Grows a volume, up to 128Gi, without a restart. A volume can grow once a running service uses it, and it can't shrink.

fields.name: exposeDatabase
fields.description: Gives a database a public hostname on port 5432. Clients have to connect with TLS, and nobody can connect until you allow their address with `addDatabaseAllowRule`.

fields.name: generateDomain
fields.description: Adds a platform domain to a service, certificate included. Each call adds another one.

fields.name: inviteMember
fields.description: Adds someone with an existing account to the workspace, by email and with a role.

fields.name: mountVolume
fields.description: Mounts a volume into a service at an absolute `path`. A volume mounts into one service, and from then on the service runs a single instance and every rollout has a short downtime.

fields.name: refreshConnector
fields.description: Checks the credential again and refreshes the list of tools.

fields.name: refreshModelProvider
fields.description: Checks the key again and refreshes the list of models.

fields.name: removeDatabaseAllowRule
fields.description: Stops allowing an address range. Removing a range that isn't allowed succeeds, and once the last range is gone, nobody can connect over the public hostname.

fields.name: removeDomain
fields.description: Removes a platform or custom domain from a service. A domain that another domain redirects to can't be removed.

fields.name: removeMember
fields.description: Removes a member from the workspace. You can't remove yourself.

fields.name: removeService
fields.description: Removes a service from its environment.

fields.name: replaceConnectorCredential
fields.description: Replaces the credential of a connector, after checking the new one.

fields.name: replaceModelProviderKey
fields.description: Replaces the key of a model provider, after checking the new one.

fields.name: restoreDatabase
fields.description: Restores the backups of a database into a new database called `name` in the same environment, leaving the original untouched. Leave `targetTime` out to restore the latest state.

fields.name: revokeApiToken
fields.description: Revokes an API token of the workspace.

fields.name: rollback
fields.description: Rolls a service back to the image of an earlier deployment, without a build. Variables and other settings stay as they are now.

fields.name: selectPlan
fields.description: Puts the workspace on a plan: switches its plan, prorated, adds one to its trial, or starts a new subscription when it has none. Returns a checkout URL instead when a card is needed first.

fields.name: sendAgentMessage
fields.description: Sends a message to a session. While the agent works, it reads the message after its current turn.

fields.name: setAgentConnectors
fields.description: Replaces the connectors an agent is granted.

fields.name: setAgentNetwork
fields.description: Replaces the network rules of an agent. `allowedHosts` takes hostnames, or `*.example.com` for the subdomains of a domain. IP addresses and a bare `*` aren't accepted.

fields.name: setAgentSessionModel
fields.description: Changes the model and effort of a session, from its next turn on.

fields.name: setAutoDeploy
fields.description: Turns deploying on every push to the tracked branch on or off.

fields.name: setBucketPublic
fields.description: Makes every object in a bucket readable by anyone at its `publicEndpoint`, or private again. Writing always needs credentials.

fields.name: setCIDeploy
fields.description: Turns keyless deploys from GitHub Actions workflows in the service's repository on or off.

fields.name: setCustomStartCommand
fields.description: Sets the command a service starts with, run through a shell. An empty string goes back to the image's default.

fields.name: setDatabaseResources
fields.description: Sets the CPU and memory of a database, within the limits in `Workspace.capabilities`.

fields.name: setDatabaseStorage
fields.description: Grows the storage of a database to `size`, such as `32Gi`, within the limits in `Workspace.capabilities`. Storage can't shrink.

fields.name: setEnvironmentResources
fields.description: Sets the tier of an environment. Services and databases pick it up the next time they are created or resized.

fields.name: setServiceBranch
fields.description: Sets the branch a service builds from, starting with its next deploy. Leave it out to follow the repository's default branch.

fields.name: setServiceHealthCheck
fields.description: Sets an HTTP health check on a path. Leave it out to go back to checking that the port accepts connections.

fields.name: setServicePort
fields.description: Sets the port a service listens on. Leave it out for a service that doesn't listen on one, and its domains stop routing to it.

fields.name: setServiceResources
fields.description: Sets the CPU and memory of a service, within the limits in `Workspace.capabilities`. The service rolls out again on the image it is already running.

fields.name: setServiceScaling
fields.description: Runs a fixed number of `replicas`, or with `autoscaling` enabled, scales between a minimum and a maximum to hold CPU at the target percentage. A service with a mounted volume runs a single instance.

fields.name: setServiceUser
fields.description: Sets the user id an image-based service runs as, which also becomes its group and the owner of its mounted volumes. Leave it out to go back to the image's default. Services built from source can't set it.

fields.name: setServiceVariables
fields.description: Replaces all variables of a service with the list given, so keys you leave out are removed. The service rolls out again on the image it is already running.

fields.name: setSharedVariables
fields.description: Replaces all shared variables of an environment with the list given, so keys you leave out are removed. Services that link to a changed key roll out again.

fields.name: startAgentSession
fields.description: Starts a session with a first message. `model` and `effort` default to the agent's last choice.

fields.name: stopAgentSession
fields.description: Stops the current turn of a session.

fields.name: unexposeDatabase
fields.description: Removes the public hostname of a database, together with its allow rules.

fields.name: unmountVolume
fields.description: Detaches a volume from its service. The data stays on the volume.

fields.name: updateAgent
fields.description: Changes the harness and instructions of an agent. The agent restarts, and running sessions end.

fields.name: updateMemberRole
fields.description: Changes the role of a member.

fields.name: updateWorkspace
fields.description: Renames the workspace. Its id stays the same.

types.name: PlanLimits
types.description: What a plan includes. Sizes are quantities such as `16Gi`, and a null count means unlimited.

types.name: PlanOffer
types.description: A plan with what it includes and what it costs a month.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Null for the free tier.

types.name: PlanSelection
types.description: The outcome of choosing a plan: the subscription now on it, or a checkout to complete first when the workspace has no card on file.

types.name: ProjectID
types.description: A project, as `workspace/project`. For example `acme/shop`.

types.name: QuantityLimit
types.description: The smallest and largest value the workspace may set, as quantities such as `250m` or `16Gi`, with the plans that allow more.

fields.name: upgrades
fields.description: Higher maximums on other plans, cheapest first. Empty on the top plan and without billing.

types.name: QuantityUpgrade
types.description: A higher maximum that another plan allows.

fields.name: agent
fields.description: One agent.

fields.name: agentAudit
fields.description: The calls an agent made to model providers and connectors, newest first, from the last 24 hours unless `since` says otherwise. At most 500 entries.

fields.name: agentModels
fields.description: The workspace's models that the agent's harness can use.

fields.name: agentSession
fields.description: One session, with its events.

fields.name: apiTokens
fields.description: The API tokens of the workspace. Their values are never returned here.

fields.name: availableVariables
fields.description: Everything a service in the environment can link to, from its databases, key-value stores, buckets and shared variables.

fields.name: bucket
fields.description: One bucket.

fields.name: bucketCredentials
fields.description: The S3 endpoint, region, bucket name and access keys for a bucket.

fields.name: bucketObjectDownloadUrl
fields.description: A link that downloads one object, valid for 15 minutes.

fields.name: bucketObjects
fields.description: The objects and folders one level below `prefix`, up to 1,000 entries.

fields.name: build
fields.description: One build, with its status.

fields.name: clientAddress
fields.description: The public IPv4 address your requests reach the platform from, or null when it can't be told. Handy for allowing your own machine to connect to a database.

fields.name: connector
fields.description: One connector.

fields.name: connectors
fields.description: The connectors of the workspace.

fields.name: database
fields.description: One database, with its status, size and resources.

fields.name: databaseCredentials
fields.description: Connection details for a database, password included. There is always an entry for the private hostname inside the environment, and one for the public hostname while the database is exposed.

fields.name: databaseTableData
fields.description: Rows of a table, a page at a time. `schema` defaults to `public`, `limit` to 50 and `offset` to 0, and a page holds at most 1,000 rows.

fields.name: databaseTables
fields.description: The tables of a database with their columns, in every schema except the system ones.

fields.name: deployment
fields.description: One deployment of a service.

fields.name: detectServices
fields.description: Inspects the default branch of a repository, given as a URL such as `https://github.com/acme/api`, and suggests a service for it with the detected language, framework and start command. The Lucity GitHub App needs access to the repository.

fields.name: ejectProject
fields.description: Exports a project as a zip archive, base64-encoded, holding a Helm chart, a values file for each environment and install instructions. The project keeps running. The values include variables and passwords, so treat the archive as a secret.

fields.name: environment
fields.description: One environment, with the services, databases, key-value stores, buckets and volumes in it.

fields.name: environments
fields.description: The environments of a project.

fields.name: githubConnected
fields.description: Whether you have connected a GitHub account.

fields.name: githubRepositories
fields.description: The repositories of a GitHub account or organization that the Lucity GitHub App can read.

fields.name: githubSources
fields.description: The GitHub accounts and organizations you can reach through the Lucity GitHub App. Needs a connected GitHub account.

fields.name: keyValueStore
fields.description: One key-value store.

fields.name: keyValueStoreCredentials
fields.description: Connection details for a key-value store, password included. Key-value stores are only reachable inside their environment.

fields.name: me
fields.description: The signed-in user, with the workspaces they belong to and their role in each.

fields.name: modelProvider
fields.description: One model provider.

fields.name: modelProviders
fields.description: The model providers connected to the workspace.

fields.name: plans
fields.description: Every plan with what it includes and costs, the free tier first. Empty without billing.

fields.name: project
fields.description: One project, with its environments.

fields.name: projects
fields.description: The projects in the workspace.

fields.name: repositoryBranches
fields.description: The branches of a repository, given as a URL such as `https://github.com/acme/api`. The Lucity GitHub App needs access to the repository.

fields.name: searchImages
fields.description: Public container images on Docker Hub that match `query`.

fields.name: service
fields.description: One service, with its configuration, endpoints and releases.

fields.name: serviceVariables
fields.description: The variables of a service. Linked variables come back with their `ref` instead of a value.

fields.name: sharedVariables
fields.description: The shared variables of an environment.

fields.name: subscription
fields.description: The plan of the workspace, with its subscription status, billing period and credit balance. Null when the workspace has never had a subscription.

fields.name: usageSummary
fields.description: The costs of the current billing period so far, in cents. Null when the workspace has never had a subscription.

fields.name: volume
fields.description: One volume.

fields.name: workspace
fields.description: The workspace the token belongs to, with its members.

fields.name: workspaces
fields.description: Every workspace you belong to.

types.name: ReleaseID
types.description: A release, as `workspace/release`. For example `acme/rel-q7m2xk`.

inputFields.name: targetTime
inputFields.description: Omit to restore the most recent state in the archive.

types.name: RestoreDatabaseResult
types.description: Restoring never touches the source database. It creates a second one holding the data as it was at `targetTime`, which keeps running alongside the original until you decide what to do with it.

fields.name: clampedToLatest
fields.description:
True when the requested moment was later than anything in the archive, so the
restore ran to the most recent state instead. Only happens while archiving is
healthy, which means nothing was written after that point.

types.name: ScanID
types.description: A secret scan, as `workspace/scan`. Take it from the release it belongs to.

fields.name: user
fields.description: The user id an image-based service runs as, which also owns its mounted volumes. Null means the image's default.

types.name: ServiceID
types.description: A service, as `workspace/project/environment/service`. For example `acme/shop/production/web`.

fields.name: line
fields.description: The log line, prefixed with the instance it came from when the service runs more than one.

fields.name: pod
fields.description: The instance that produced the line.

inputFields.name: key
inputFields.description: The name of the variable, such as `PORT` or `HOST`.

inputFields.name: ref
inputFields.description: Links the variable to one from `availableVariables`. Set either `value` or `ref`.

inputFields.name: value
inputFields.description: A literal value. Set either `value` or `ref`.

types.name: SetEnvironmentResourcesInput
types.description: `ECO` lets services share capacity and burst beyond what is reserved for them. `PRODUCTION` reserves the full CPU and memory of every service.

types.name: StorageCapability
types.description: Creating volumes or key-value stores, and the size of one.

types.name: String
types.description: The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

fields.name: agentSessionEvents
fields.description: The events of a session, starting after the event `after`, or from the beginning without it, and following new ones.

fields.name: buildLogs
fields.description: The output of a build, streamed as it is produced.

fields.name: deployLogs
fields.description: The output of the deploy step of a release, streamed as it is produced.

fields.name: scanLogs
fields.description: The output of a secret scan, streamed as it is produced.

fields.name: serviceLogs
fields.description: The runtime logs of the running instances of a service, starting with the last `tailLines` lines of each (1,000 by default) and following new output. Instances that start later, for example during a rollout, are not included.

types.name: Time
types.description: A point in time as an RFC 3339 string, such as `2026-09-28T14:05:00Z`.

types.name: VariableID
types.description: A variable that a database, key-value store, bucket or shared variable provides. Take the ids from `availableVariables`.

inputFields.name: key
inputFields.description: The name of the variable, such as `PORT` or `HOST`.

types.name: VolumeID
types.description: A volume, as `workspace/project/environment/volume`. For example `acme/shop/production/uploads`.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: What the workspace can create, how large, and what unlocks the rest. Anything it doesn't allow is refused.

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.

enumValues.name: QUERY
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a query operation.

enumValues.name: MUTATION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a mutation operation.

enumValues.name: SUBSCRIPTION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a subscription operation.

enumValues.name: FIELD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment definition.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_SPREAD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment spread.

enumValues.name: INLINE_FRAGMENT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an inline fragment.

enumValues.name: VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a variable definition.

enumValues.name: SCHEMA
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a schema definition.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a scalar definition.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an object type definition.

enumValues.name: FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field definition.

enumValues.name: ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an argument definition.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an interface definition.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a union definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM_VALUE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum value definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object type definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object field definition.

enumValues.name: DIRECTIVE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a directive definition.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.description: A GraphQL-formatted string representing the default value for this input value.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional `specifiedByURL`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. `fields` and `interfaces` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields`, `interfaces`, and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. `possibleTypes` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. `enumValues` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. `ofType` is a valid field.

directives.name: deprecated
directives.description: Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.

args.name: reason
args.description: Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted using the Markdown syntax, as specified by [CommonMark](https://commonmark.org/).

directives.name: include
directives.description: Directs the executor to include this field or fragment only when the `if` argument is true.

directives.name: oneOf
directives.description: Indicates exactly one field must be supplied and this field must not be `null`.

directives.name: skip
directives.description: Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the `if` argument is true.

directives.name: specifiedBy
directives.description: Exposes a URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

args.name: url
args.description: The URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.
